scope: local clinician-supervised prototype; control mapping only

risks.name: Prompt Injection
risks.gap: Static synthetic payload tests do not demonstrate resistance to adaptive or invisible multimodal attacks.

risks.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
risks.gap: No independent red-team assessment of all logs, traces, browser storage and host-level artifacts.

risks.name: Excessive Agency
risks.gap: Model outputs remain proposals; privileged production integrations and institutional authorization are not validated.

risks.name: Supply Chain
risks.gap: Local hashes and pinned dependencies do not constitute an external supply-chain audit.

risks.name: Data and Model Poisoning
risks.gap: No training pipeline is in scope; development data provenance and lexicon bias require continued review.

risks.name: Unbounded Consumption
risks.gap: OS-level quotas, host egress policy and full deployment resource envelopes are not established.

risks.name: Misinformation
risks.gap: Automated source agreement does not establish factual or clinical correctness.

risks.name: Hidden Context Exposure
risks.gap: Prompt secrecy and hidden context confidentiality are not guaranteed; no external disclosure red-team was run.

risks.name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
risks.gap: No vector database or retrieval-augmented generation store is used; reassess before adding one.

risks.name: Improper Output Handling
risks.gap: Application validation and escaping tests do not replace deployment-specific output-sink review.

interpretation: This crosswalk identifies current code evidence and gaps; it is not OWASP certification or an external security audit.
